subject: Update regarding your note about the delivery window
text:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out about the delivery window. I understand why the timing caught your attention, and I appreciate you mentioning it directly. The early arrivals have been harder to control this week because the supplier changed the routing schedule temporarily, but I have asked for the updated delivery list and should have a clearer answer by tomorrow afternoon.

In the meantime, I have requested that packages be left on the side porch rather than near the front steps, and I will ask the drivers to knock quietly. If there is a particular hour that creates more disruption, please let me know and I will pass it along promptly. I will also keep this limited to the next two business days unless the change is extended.

I apologize for the inconvenience this has caused and want to make sure the solution is practical for everyone nearby.

Best regards,
